items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: she was with Papa Celestin's orchestra oh, for quite awhile.

ctx.x: We talked before about women with bands and I asked you wasn't it rather unusual for you, especially at your age, to be playing with a band, and you mentioned that there were several women around New Orleans. You named one, Jeanette Kimball. You said she was with --
Papa Celestin, , right. She was marvelous, marvelous pianist.
